attributes.board_name: Michigan Board of Nursing (LARA Bureau of Professional Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs offered or approved by ANCC, ACCME, AMA, AOA, AANA, AANP, ACNM, NACNS, NAPNES, NLN, another state/provincial board of nursing or a board-approved nursing program; also limited credit for academic courses, specialty exams, publications, presentations, precepting, committee work
rules.new_licensee_rule: The 25 hours apply to nurses who held the license for the full 2 years before expiration.
rules.audit_note: Renewal application certifies compliance; keep documentation 4 years after renewal; the board may request proof.
rules.notes: Max 12 hours in 24 hours. Implicit bias: 1 hour per year of the cycle, may also count toward CE. One-time human trafficking training earns no CE credit and has no fixed hours.
